title: Implement POST /api/batches/[id]/media route
description: Create the media upload API route. Accepts multipart form data with image files, validates filename convention, saves files to the media directory, and records them in the media table.
acceptanceCriteria: Files with invalid names return 400 with details of which files failed
Valid files are saved to public/uploads/{batchId}/
Each file is recorded in the media table (batch_id, slot, industry, url, source='upload')
Returns 201 with array of created media records

steps.details: Export POST handler. Use `request.formData()` to parse the multipart body. Extract all File entries.

For each file, run regex: `/^([a-z_]+)-([a-z_]+)-([a-z0-9_]+)\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$/i`. Collect invalid filenames. If any invalid, return 400 JSON with `{ errors: ['filename.jpg: invalid name format'] }`.
Create directory `public/uploads/{batchId}/` if not exists. Write each file's ArrayBuffer to disk using `fs.writeFile`. Relative URL: `/uploads/{batchId}/{filename}`.
For each saved file, parse slot and industry from filename. Insert record into media table via `createMedia({ batchId, slot, industry, url, source: 'upload' })`. Return 201 with all created records.
Upload a valid test image via curl with `--form`. Verify the file appears in public/uploads/ and the DB record is created. Test with an invalid filename and verify 400 response.
